jurisdiction: City of Philadelphia, Philadelphia County, Pennsylvania
permitOffice: Philadelphia Department of Licenses and Inspections (L&I)
zoningCode: Philadelphia Zoning Code (Title 14, The Philadelphia Code)

irc.amendments: 2021 IRC as amended (Subcode R); applications on or after 2026-07-01 must use 2021, earlier may use 2018 or 2021

elec.islandReceptacleRequired.amendment: Restores peninsular countertops and islands to kitchen receptacle requirements as in the 2018 IRC (pending bill 260395)

notes: Local ceiling heights R-R305.1: 7 ft habitable, 6 ft 8 in bathrooms/laundry (same as base). Cool-roof requirement for low-slope roofs; builder must offer sprinkler option (R-R313.2). Zone 4A.
